figurative_meaning_bn: প্রায় একার্থক যুগ্মশব্দ; আনা ধরণের অসুখ; সমার্থক বাগধারা
figurative_meaning_en: A near-synonymous compound word; minor or chronic ailments; synonymous expressions for sickness and discomfort
example_sentences_in_bangla: শীতকালে ছোটখাটো রোগব্যাধি সবাইকেই আক্রমণ করে।
example_sentences_in_english: In old age, one is constantly afflicted with ailments.
During winter, everyone suffers from minor illnesses.
note: This is a tautological compound emphasizing persistent minor health issues in Bengali vernacular.
